verdict.rationale: NVIDIA provides official SDKs (CUDA Toolkit, CUDA Tile C++/cuTile Python, RTX Neural Shaders SDK, RTX Mega Geometry, Nsight tools) that developers can build AI/graphics applications against, all documented on NVIDIA's developer portal. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of building against these SDKs, and deeper API reference/sample documentation beyond marketing-style descriptions.
